study_identification_part.si4_title: Mapping the neuroanatomical heterogeneity of OCD using a framework integrating normative model and non-negative matrix factorization

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study's objectives are clearly stated: to estimate neuroanatomical heterogeneity in OCD using a normative model and NMF.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: To quantitatively estimate the heterogeneity of OCD, we proposed a novel framework integrating the normative model and non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) from a dimensional perspective.

The Image Quality Rating (IQR) combing image noise contrast ratio... was recorded to assess images quality
